subject: Quick fit: embeddings & chat pilot — snapshot and slot poll
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@shopline.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick fit: embeddings & chat pilot — snapshot and slot poll

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood. I pulled your signup record and wanted to ask a few quick qualification questions so we can tailor the demo and keep it to 30 minutes: 

1) Primary use case: are you planning to power product search embeddings, chat with context, or both? A short sentence helps.
2) Expected steady-state volume: approximate daily embedding vectors and average concurrent chat turns or messages per second. Rough buckets are fine (e.g., 10k/day, 200k/day).
3) Timeline: when would you like to run a short pilot? (weeks/months)

If you can reply with those details I can pick the right engineer and prep a short traffic snapshot to show realistic latency/cost. I attached a one-pager and a quickdeck with examples.

If it helps, here are three slots on my calendar — pick one and I’ll send an invite:
- Tue Sep 14, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Tue Sep 14, 15:30–16:00 PT
- Wed Sep 15, 09:00–09:30 PT

Also: is there a security contact we should loop in for a short checklist?

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_quickdeck.pdf (application/pdf, 320KB)
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@shopline.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2026 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick fit: embeddings & chat pilot — snapshot and slot poll

Hi Karthik — thanks for reaching out. Quick answers below.

1) Use case: primary goal is product search relevance via embeddings (hybrid retrieval + re-rank) and a secondary internal-facing chat assistant for returns/fulfillment.
2) Volume: we expect ~200k embedding requests/day at launch with spikes up to 350k on peak promos; chat is smaller — roughly 6k–9k chat turns/day (mostly during business hours).
3) Timeline: interested in a 4–6 week pilot starting mid-October. We need basic SSO and an audit log for the pilot.

Security contact: security@shopline.ai (CC'd here).

Of the slots you suggested, Tue Sep 14 at 15:30 PT works best for us. Could you also share any pricing range for embedding units for pilot-scale?

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Head of ML & Search, Shopline.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@shopline.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick fit: embeddings & chat pilot — snapshot and slot poll

Hi Olivia — great context, appreciate the numbers. Quick follow-ups and next steps: 

- Confirmed our slot: Tue Sep 14, 15:30 PT (placeholder invite to follow).
- Pricing: for a pilot at your estimated volume we usually run a blended quote — I’ll include a ballpark in the invite; final pricing depends on model choice (open LLM vs fine-tuned), quantization, and caching.
- Attachments: attaching a short "pilot_requirements.pdf" with the data prep checklist (format, sample size for embeddings, retention notes) and a lightweight SSO checklist.

HubSpot: your record is under DEAL-2026-734 — I added the pilot milestone and flagged security for a short questionnaire. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2026-734

Monica — can you join the demo to cover SSO/SSPR and quick audit-log questions?

Ben
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: pilot_requirements.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)
